persona: (a) Mr. Rahim Uddin, district health officer, Cox's Bazar (BD2022). SIMULATED persona walkthrough run with an AI agent, not a real participant. Round 2 (confirm round). View ?district=BD2022, width 1366. 4 browser runs in total (run 2's printed output was lost to a parsing error in my script, so run 3 repeated it; its screenshot was kept).

tasks.stuck: Fixed: the line 'On alert in the last full week (week of 22 Dec 25, EARS C2 (fast rises)): none.' answers the question at once. The table now has 'Alert now: no'. 'Cases last full week' shows real numbers (Cox's Bazar dengue 38, Dhaka division 2,252). Headers are plain words. Still there: the ranking still compares my district with eight divisions, every division row says 'no' / 0 as if it had been checked, and the table is still cut off on the right ('Weekly ca...'; the next-week column is hidden). NEW: on the dengue map, Cox's Bazar shows a SOLID triangle, which the legend says means 'on alert in the last full week', while the top line says 'none' and the table says 'no'. Cause, for the developers: CSS '.alert-marker { fill: var(--alert) }' in css/style.css overrides the fill='none' attribute that map.js sets for 'earlier' alerts, so every triangle is drawn solid. NEW (small): for malaria, the 'Alert weeks' cell shows '0' with an orange bar next to it.
quotes: Good, one line at the top: no alert this week. But the map triangle is filled in, and the legend says filled means alert now. Which one is right?

issues.problem: Every triangle is drawn solid ('on alert in the last full week') because the CSS fill overrides map.js fill='none'. Cox's Bazar dengue shows solid while the top line says 'none'.
issues.suggested_fix: Move fill/stroke for the outline case into a CSS class (e.g. .alert-marker.earlier { fill: none; stroke: var(--alert) }), or set it with .style() instead of .attr().

issues.problem: 'this plan sends 9,237 and covers 47% of the shortfall' when the national shortfall is 684. Cox's Bazar receives 161, still short 124. More money gives worse coverage and massive over-sending.
issues.suggested_fix: Check the allocation optimiser at high budget and α=1 (per-district cap at shortfall, or population share applied to the wrong base); add a test that 'sends' never exceeds total shortfall unless that is explained.

issues.problem: '50% of the cost of all need' while IV saline covers 16% and ORS 75%, with no explanation.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a sentence saying the budget is shared across supplies by cost and urgency, so coverage differs per supply.

issues.problem: Still clipped at 1366 px ('Weekly ca...', next-week column hidden). Division rows are still shown as evaluated. Malaria 'Alert weeks 0' shows an orange bar.
issues.suggested_fix: Narrow or wrap the columns; show '–' for division rows; hide the bar when the count is 0.

issues.problem: A grey budget line crosses the allocation legend; the grey lines for other budgets are unlabeled.
issues.suggested_fix: Clip the chart to its own area; label the lines or add a legend.

issues.problem: LaTeX residue 'lcccc@{}}'. The calendar has no malaria or ILI columns. Districts are not mapped to divisions. 'Click a district' does not apply to the district view. Nothing is addressed to district officers.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the residue; add malaria to the calendar; add a 'For district officers' paragraph; reword the view instructions.
